feature: Offboarding - the real artifacts/portal '/offboarding' page ('Leaving', src/pages/offboarding.tsx), part of #1653/#1485. Design: Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Offboarding.dc.html. Contract pack: Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/docs/offboarding-contract-pack.md (#2444). Covers this build's own scope: GET /api/portal/customer/export (export preview + real download, contract pack §6) and POST /api/portal/customer/offboard (end services, mspId===1 only, §5), wired via offboardingLive.ts/offboardingWire.ts. Also covers this build's own addition of a real `mspName` field to GET /api/portal/dashboard (portal-customer-engines.ts), used for the brokered-customer 'served by <name>' copy.
notes: #2766 (ghost-mode UI for customer-deleted records) and #2767 (post-termination gated 'come back and download your data' screen) are real, separately-scoped open issues checked explicitly against this landed design and NOT resolved by it - the design's own ledger states 'No undo and no reactivate. Nothing resets an inactive organisation from the portal' and draws no per-route gate screen. Both issues are left open; this build does not close either.

The MSP-side 3-step offboarding console (POST /msp/offboarding/request|export|archive, contract pack §2-4) is a different Feature (the provider's own operator surface) and is NOT drawn by the landed Offboarding.dc.html (a single customer-facing 'Leaving' page with an active/brokered/inactive scene switch) - not wired here, matching the design as shipped.

WHAT THIS COVERS: GET /api/portal/customer/export (auth-gated + real payload shape) and POST /api/portal/customer/offboard (auth-gated). The real write (POST /offboard) is NOT exercised end-to-end here - it immediately, irreversibly pauses every active/paused client_services row and marks the tenant inactive for whichever account authenticates, the same real-write caution billing.json's Stripe-portal POST and account-security-data-rights.json's deletion-request POST document for their own destructive/side-effecting actions.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (no portal login page yet): artifacts/portal has no login page today (#1648) - App.tsx's RequireAuth renders an honest 'Sign in required' panel for an unauthenticated visitor, the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/billing.json documents. The uiSteps below only assert what is honestly reachable today.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).

Verified instead by a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) on both artifacts/portal and artifacts/api-server, and a real `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal with this page + route added.
